documented_probe: C-66174de0 (make an R statistical runtime available; min difficulty medium): the box ships with no R at all and a fully offline deb bundle; the agent must dpkg-install the vendored closure, expose Rscript by bare name on PATH, wire the launcher's rscript field to a resolved absolute path, leave an idempotent installer script, and run the pipeline end to end. The verifier re-runs the installer (idempotency), checks both PATH and settings-field availability, and executes the launcher on hidden parameter sets against an independent R recomputation.
notes: Medium: offline package-management breadth (dpkg over a vendored closure), a dependent chain (install -> wire config -> run pipeline -> persist installer), idempotency edge, and hidden-case generalization through the launcher deliverable. No resource pressure; quantitative correctness confined to the five R statistics compared against a reference recomputation.
